description: Read public discussion threads attached to an entity, topic, or section. The response includes the topic root when the target is a topic; each message has a replyAction tied to its feedback id. Replies are optional. Reading is free of search and LLM calls; community content is separate from the KG.

limit.description: Maximum feedback items to return, including replies.

offset.description: Offset for reading the next page; check hasMore/nextOffset.

targetId.description: Stable entity id, topic id/slug, or section id. Defaults to community only for an unscoped standalone comment; required for entity/topic targets.

targetType.description: Target type. Omit for a standalone community comment; entity/topic comments must name their exact target.

name: list_feedback
title: List public feedback threads
